regression_results.assertion_summary: Verified cutover execution through discrete sequential checkpoints; fault injection at pre-flip and post-flip checkpoints resumes or aborts with unambiguous single authority
Verified epoch worker fence strictly rejects stale workers carrying obsolete epochs and records security audit events
Verified canary metric monitoring halts cohort expansion on error rate or stock mismatch threshold breaches and exposes structured recovery options without automatic rollback
Verified parent product and all child variants and stock owners flip authority and epoch atomically in a single transaction; partial cutovers are strictly rejected

acceptance.observation: Crash mỗi checkpoint resume/abort có nguồn chuẩn rõ; old workers reject; no checkout stock double mutation
Error/mismatch threshold tự halt mở rộng và expose recovery, không tự rollback dữ liệu chưa mirror-ready
